pages.text: Gold and iron lamps and lanterns can mount on the floor, a wall, or the ceiling. Right-click with dye to change their shade. Both drills cycle the mount. Sneak-use the drill to rotate the light.
A gold lamp. The iron version uses iron hardware.
An iron lamp. It gives the same light as gold.
Lanterns show a flame inside the glass.
All four lights keep their shade when picked up.
